name: Feature 14 — RAG as a Tool:
Launches the full RAG wizard from smart-workflow-demo (com.axonivy.utils.smart.workflow.demo.rag.RagDemo).
Step 1: Configure — review OpenSearch connection settings and test connection.
Step 2: Upload & Embed — upload .txt/.md files and embed into OpenSearch as vector chunks.
Step 3: Results — inspect indexed chunks with source file and content preview.
Step 4: Chat — ask questions answered by an AI agent using the openSearchSearch tool.
